$comment: Curated nicknames for mutation classes. Source of truth (docs/PHASE2.md §5). Each entry names a class by id AND by a member matrix, so it can be re-resolved if ids are ever re-keyed. Validate with `python scripts/nicknames.py --check`; render with `--sql`.

nicknames.note: The Markov quiver: an oriented 3-cycle with every arrow doubled. Its mutation class is a single quiver up to relabeling, and it is the smallest quiver that is not mutation-acyclic.
